in_arabic.name: Mashia
in_arabic.long_meaning: Mashia هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'sh-a-w-h' which means to help, support, or assist. In Islamic tradition, the name Mashia symbolizes providing guidance, support, and care to those in need.
